rounds.text: Empower India Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, as evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.88x [E2]. This valuation suggests that the market is pricing the company below the value of its net assets, providing a margin of safety for investors [E2]. While the company has faced historical challenges, the most recent data indicates a powerful turnaround in profitability, with quarterly operating margins surging by 30 percentage points compared to the year-ago quarter [E24]. This shift confirms the signal that margins are actively expanding [E63]. Conceded: the company offers no dividend yield [E4], and long-term compounded sales growth has remained modest at 4% [E8]. Furthermore, the current ROCE of 5.3% and ROE of 5.8% reflect a period of low capital efficiency [E6, E7]. Despite these historical headwinds, the stock’s momentum, sitting at 78% of its 52-week range, reflects growing market recognition of this operational improvement [E5].
